workData.title: Will TAP
workData.subTitle: Developed a smart home app for luxury apartments in Japan, achieving 80% adoption with an intuitive and seamless user experience.

content.text: Role
Senior Product Designer
Project Space
Smart Home App
0-1 Projects
B2C

As the Senior Product Designer for Will TAP, a smart home app tailored for residents of Nomura Real Estate’s Proud apartments in Japan, I worked to create a seamless and user-friendly interface that allows residents to control smart home devices and receive essential notifications. The app also offers additional features designed to enhance the convenience and quality of life for apartment residents.
The goal was to balance diverse functionalities with intuitive design, ensuring accessibility for all users while integrating smoothly with smart home systems.

Will TAP was developed as a comprehensive smart home solution for Proud apartment residents, offering a wide range of features to improve daily living. The main challenge was managing the complexity of these features while ensuring ease of use and smooth device integration.
Main Features
My Home Functions
: Remote control and monitoring of locks, security settings, and select appliances (e.g., air conditioning, lighting, heating, floor heating).
Apartment Functions
: Reservation system for shared facilities and access to a digital library for equipment manuals and various application forms.
City Functions
: Access to community-related information, events, and shared spaces through a dedicated member web portal.
Notification Functions
: Alerts for lock/unlock status, parcel deliveries, management announcements, and shared space reservation updates.
Additional Features
: Family and appliance management, operation history, personal settings, and access to management rules.
Target Properties
The app is currently implemented in Proud City Hiyoshi and will be introduced to additional Proud series properties in the future.
Hypothesis
Organizing the app’s diverse functionalities into intuitive categories would improve usability and encourage adoption.
Providing seamless integration with smart home devices would ensure high functionality and satisfaction.
Clear communication of the app's capabilities would enhance user trust and engagement.
Streamlined UX Design
Categorized the app’s features into intuitive sections to simplify navigation and enhance usability.
Designed a unified interface that ensures all features are easily accessible and understandable for a wide range of users.
Collaborative Integration
Worked closely with appliance manufacturers to ensure the seamless functionality of remote controls and monitoring systems.
Partnered with system administrators to align the app’s design with technical and operational requirements.
Comprehensive Feature Implementation
Designed specialized modules for key features, such as smart home controls, shared facility reservations, community updates, and notifications, ensuring an all-in-one solution.
Developed flexible settings to accommodate the unique requirements of different Proud properties.
Activation
App MAUs
Impact
Achieved an 80% adoption rate among Proud apartment residents since the app’s 2019 launch.
Delivered a comprehensive smart home solution that combines convenience, community engagement, and efficient property management.
Enhanced user satisfaction by integrating advanced features such as appliance control, notifications, and shared facility management.
Learning
Intuitive categorization of complex features significantly improves usability and adoption rates.
Close collaboration with hardware manufacturers is essential for seamless smart home device integration.
A holistic approach to community and home management features fosters engagement and trust among residents.

This project successfully demonstrated how thoughtful design and feature integration can transform a smart home app into a comprehensive lifestyle solution for residents, supporting both daily convenience and community engagement.

Project Space
Co-Working Space Digital Platform

B2B
B2C
point 0 marunouchi is a co-working space launched in July 2019, redefining the “future of office spaces” by integrating advanced technologies and supporting diverse working styles.

As the Product Designer for point 0 marunouchi, I designed the website and app to reflect the space’s high-end, futuristic concept while providing a seamless user experience. The app included features such as reservations, payments, announcements, and location services, catering to the needs of busy professionals.

point 0 marunouchi offers a unique co-working experience with open spaces, meeting rooms, and nap booths equipped with cutting-edge solutions. Leveraging advanced data collection and biometrics, the space continuously improves its offerings through analysis and experimentation.

In January 2021, it became the first co-working office in Japan to earn WELL Certification (WELL v2 pilot) at the Gold level. This achievement was made possible through partnerships with Okamura Corporation, Daikin Industries, and Panasonic, incorporating expertise in air quality, furniture, and lighting.

As a testbed for WORKTECH innovations, point 0 marunouchi hosts unique experiments and initiatives led by 17 participating companies, including Daikin, Okamura, Panasonic, TOTO, Asahi, Epson, Microsoft, and Sony. Starting with 10 committee members at launch, this network quickly expanded within a year.
Registered members: 809 → 1696 (2x growth)
Corporate contracts: 16 → 30 (2x growth)
Individual contracts: 80 → 303 (3.8x growth)
Hypothesis
A user-friendly website and app design would align with the space’s premium and innovative concept.
Intuitive app features, such as reservations and location services, would enhance user engagement and satisfaction.
Highlighting advanced technologies and high-end solutions would position point 0 marunouchi as a leading workspace for professionals.
Website Design
Designed a premium website with calming colors and sophisticated layouts, targeting business professionals while emphasizing innovation.
App Design
Developed an intuitive app with key features, including reservations, payments, announcements, and location services.
Simplified navigation with minimalistic layouts to streamline interactions and improve usability.
Ensured the app’s design aligned with the branding of point 0 marunouchi, reinforcing its high-end identity.
Registered members
2x
Corporate contracts
2x
Individual contracts
Impact
Increased user engagement through intuitive app features for bookings, payments, and community interactions.
Positioned point 0 marunouchi as a leading co-working space recognized for its advanced technology and user-centered design.
Achieved Japan’s first WELL Certification (WELL v2 pilot) for a co-working office.
Registered members grew from 809 to 1696, corporate contracts doubled from 16 to 30, and individual memberships increased 3.8x from 80 to 303.
Learning
Clear and intuitive design plays a crucial role in improving satisfaction for multifunctional apps.
Showcasing innovative technologies enhances brand perception and appeal to professionals.
Consistency across digital platforms and physical spaces builds trust and strengthens brand identity.

This project positioned point 0 marunouchi as an innovative, luxurious workspace that sets a new standard for future office spaces by combining advanced technology, thoughtful design, and seamless user experiences.
